title: BBVA and OpenAI collaborate to transform global banking
summary: BBVA is expanding its work with OpenAI through a multi-year AI transformation program, rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise to all 120,000 employees. Together, the companies will develop AI solutions that enhance customer interactions, streamline operations, and help build an AI-native banking experience.
body: BBVA is expanding its work with OpenAI through a multi-year AI transformation program, rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise to all 120,000 employees. Together, the companies will develop AI solutions that enhance customer interactions, streamline operations, and help build an AI-native banking experience.
summaryZh: 西班牙对外银行（BBVA）宣布与OpenAI深化合作，将ChatGPT Enterprise部署至全球12万名员工。双方将共同开发AI解决方案，旨在通过AI原生技术重塑银行的客户交互模式与运营流程，推动银行业的数字化转型。
